content:
Sam K.: quick idea — want to map the full client-visible error *journey* (api response -> console badge -> dashboard link) so customers get actionable guidance not cryptic codes. ptal?
Mira C.: love it. can we scope to routing/quota/deg degrade -> yes/no retry semantics first?
Jon P.: +1. we also need telemetry hooks so the console can show the right runbook link and sample requests.
Tara L.: can someone post a minimal example of the response contract we want apps to depend on?
Sam K.: sure — rough sketch below. main goal: stable fields, short human hint, machine flags for retryable/runbook.
Sam K.: ```json
{
  "status": "degraded",
  "code": "ROUTE_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED",
  "message": "Serving capacity in your region is temporarily constrained.",
  "hint": "Switch to a lower-cost model or try again after 10s.",
  "retryable": false,
  "fallback": { "model": "gptx-small", "mode": "best-effort" },
  "runbook_url": "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/route-capacity",
  "telemetry_tags": ["route:us-east-1","tier:dedicated","quota:soft"]
}
```
Mira C.: looks good. question: should `hint` be localized or only console copies localized by the UI?
Tara L.: prefer UI-localized. keep contract english-only to avoid duplication. console will translate.
Anika R.: for telemetry: add `error_class` field (enum: routing/quota/runtime/validation) and `sample_rate` for noisy errors so we don't overload logs.
Jon P.: agree re sample_rate. also add `client_visible_id` — stable short id we can use in support links and user copy.
Sam K.: ok new sketch: add `error_class` and `client_visible_id`. we should keep payload small.
Mira C.: about badges — should console treat `degraded` vs `failed` differently? e.g., yellow vs red, with different CTA?
Tara L.: yes. yellow -> 'degraded (best-effort)' CTA = 'see suggestions', red -> 'failed' CTA = 'contact support / fallback'.
Anika R.: telemetry mapping idea: tag events with `badge_state` (ok/degraded/failed) + `reason_code` = the `code` value. dashboards can pivot on these two.
Jon P.: and add `route_resolution` telemetry: which fallback triggered, if any. helps explain cost/latency regressions.
Sam K.: rollout UX: when we change mapping logic, console should show timeline and sampling (e.g., v1->v2 mapping) and let customers preview what they'd see.
Mira C.: preview mode is critical. otherwise subtle wording changes become support churn.
Tara L.: runbook attachment: make runbook_url optional, but when present make the console show a short runbook excerpt inline + link to full doc.
Anika R.: sampling plan: noisy 429-like signals sample 0.1% full payload and store aggregated counters at 1s granularity. we should include `sample_id` when payload sampled.
Jon P.: note about SDKs: they often swallow `hint` fields. recommend SDKs expose raw `error` object and a helper `isRetryable(err)` that checks `retryable`.
Sam K.: ops ask: what about rate-limits that are per-tenant vs per-route? we need both code variants so console can show tenant-level quota vs route-level guidance.
Mira C.: suggestion: prefix code with scope: `TENANT_QUOTA_*` vs `ROUTE_QUOTA_*`. keeps it parseable.
Tara L.: small nit: we should avoid exposing internal kernel names in `code`. keep them focused on customer action.
Anika R.: telemetry tags example: `["scope:tenant","quota_bucket:write_tokens","route_candidate:gptx-large"]` — console can turn those into actionable UI panels.
Sam K.: next steps: 1) finalize contract fields (Sam/Mira) 2) implement telemetry tags + sampling (Anika/Jon) 3) console badge + preview UX (Tara) 4) SDK helpers + docs (Eng DX)
Jon P.: I'll open a tiny RFC with the contract and sampling defaults. will include compatibility notes for existing error codes.
Mira C.: add a migration plan to the RFC — e.g., dual-emit legacy `status_code` for 30 days and include mapping table.
Tara L.: can we also add a quick snippet for runbook teaser (1-2 bullets) in the contract? maybe `runbook_teaser` 140 chars. helps previews without deep linking.
Sam K.: yes — `runbook_teaser` ok, optional. thanks everyone.
DevBot: New RFC created by Jon P. — https://go.redwood/rfc/error-journey-mapping (PR opened) :thumbsup:
Anika R.: I'll pair with Jon on the sampling section tomorrow. :calendar:
Mira C.: thanks — will draft the preview UX flows after we have the contract. :eyes:
Sam K.: closing loop: aim to land RFC end of week, and a pilot for one route next sprint. :rocket:
